name: Rudra Andalfite
original_name: ルドラ＝アンダルファイト
source:
A young boy who was raised as a bodyguard in the battlefield when he was younger, similar to [url=https://vndb.org/c20714]Yuria[/url]. The Fourth Seat of the "Seventh Chord". In order to survive in the battlefield without any mentors, he grew up fighting. Due to his sense of pride for his combat abilities, he tends to fight alone without relying on his teammates in battle. However, he does show respect towards others's abilities. Hence, he has a good camaraderie towards the other members in the "Seventh Chord".

Rudra has the talent of a genius when it comes to magic combat. During his days in the military, his hand-to-hand combat skills were enough to put the other adult soldiers to shame despite being a child soldier at the time.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853984]Getchu[/url]]
